chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a woman whose shift or waist-wrapper is with her, and it is affected by moisture from the private part while she is in janabah: may she perform salat (prayer) in it? He said: “When she performs ghusl, she may perform salat (prayer) in them both.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: Can a woman perform salat (prayer) in clothes touched by vaginal moisture after ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman in janabah whose garment is touched by moisture from the private part. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that after she performs ghusl, she may perform salat (prayer) in those garments, indicating no further prohibition mentioned here regarding praying in them.
